info.title: SOS App — Backend API
info.description:
Snap or Slap challenge app. Sprint 5: Active Challenge & Check-in System (submit checkin, today status, gallery, stats, nudge). All endpoints return JSON. No auth — use ?user_id=UUID.

Test accounts: alice@example.com / bob@example.com / charlie@example.com / diana@example.com / edward@example.com (password: Password123!)

get.description: Returns server status and uptime. No auth required.

post.description: Create account with email, password, username. Returns JWT tokens.
Authenticate with email + password. Returns JWT tokens.

get.description: Check if a username is available. No auth required. Test in browser: /api/auth/check-username?username=cool_user

post.description: Exchange refresh_token for new access_token. Old refresh_token is revoked (rotation).
Revoke refresh token. Access token expires naturally (15min).

get.description: Get profile by user_id query param. Test in browser: /api/users/me?user_id=UUID

patch.description: Update display_name, bio, is_private. Requires user_id query param.

get.description: Returns all users, challenges, members, checkins from the database. Test in browser.
Search users by username prefix. Test: /api/users/search?q=maya&user_id=YOUR_UUID
Paginated list of accepted friends. Test: /api/friends?user_id=UUID

post.description: Send a friend request to another user.

409.description: Already friends or request already sent

put.description: Respond to an incoming friend request.

get.description: Privacy-aware profile. Friends see full data; strangers see limited info. Test: /api/users/TARGET_UUID/profile?user_id=YOUR_UUID

Get paginated list of challenges the user has joined. Supports status filter.

Test: /api/challenges?user_id=ALICE_UUID&status=active

post.description: Create a challenge. Creator becomes the host automatically. Challenge starts in 'formation' status.

get.description: Get full challenge info including members list. If user_id provided, also returns the viewer's membership info.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Current viewer ID (optional, to get my_membership)

patch.description: Update challenge settings. Only the host can edit, and only while status is 'formation'.

400.description: Validation error or challenge not in formation

404.description: Challenge not found or not the host

delete.description: Delete a formation challenge or cancel an active challenge. Only the host can perform this action. Completed/failed challenges cannot be deleted.

404.description: Challenge not found or not the host

post.description: Host invites friends to a formation challenge. Only the host can invite. Invitees must be friends. Skips users already in the challenge.

userIds.description: Array of friend user IDs to invite

400.description: Validation error or invitee not a friend

409.description: Challenge not in formation or no slots available

post.description: Accept an invitation to join a challenge. Must have been invited and challenge must be in formation.

409.description: Challenge not in formation or full

get.description: View invited members for a challenge. Browser-testable GET endpoint.

post.description: Decline an invitation to a challenge. Must have been invited.

put.description: Toggle is_ready for an accepted member. Only works during formation. Returns readiness count.

get.description: View all accepted members and their ready status. Browser-testable.

post.description: Leave a formation challenge. Host cannot leave (must cancel instead). Only works during formation.

400.description: Host cannot leave or challenge is active

get.description:
Search/browse public formation challenges that are not full. Optionally exclude challenges user is already in. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/public?q=wake&user_id=UUID

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Exclude challenges user is already in

post.description:
Submit a check-in for the current cycle. Auto-calculates cycle number from challenge start_at.

Test: POST with { "caption": "Day 4 done!" }

409.description: Challenge not active / already checked in

get.description:
Paginated list of all check-ins with user info. Filter by member_id. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/{id}/checkins?page=1&limit=10

View all members' check-in status for the current cycle with countdown to reset. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/{id}/checkins/today

Aggregated stats: completion rate, top performer, per-member breakdown. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/{id}/stats

post.description:
Send a nudge notification to a member who hasn't checked in. Rate limited: 1 nudge per target per day per challenge.

Requires user_id query param (the nudger).

400.description: Cannot nudge self / target already checked in

403.description: Both users must be accepted members

get.description:
View recent nudges for a member in a challenge. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/{id}/nudge/{memberId}

description.example: 30 days of waking up early! Snap a photo of your alarm clock.

UpdateChallengeDto.description: All fields optional. Only allowed when challenge status is 'formation'.
